misses.mechanism: form-data parsing through a dependency range that forces known-vulnerable python-multipart releases
misses.behavior: The test extra constrains python-multipart to >=0.0.5,<0.0.7. Every permitted version is affected by CVE-2024-24762; FastAPI calls request.form() for Form body fields, so a form-parsing test environment resolves a dependency with the Content-Type ReDoS. This does not establish an installed production version because the runtime extra can resolve a patched release and no lockfile was present.
misses.evidence: Source at d666ccb6: pyproject.toml:53-70 contains the test-extra range; fastapi/routing.py:183-198 selects Form fields and awaits request.form(). Primary advisory GHSA-2jv5-9r88-3w3p / CVE-2024-24762 states python-multipart <=0.0.6 is affected and 0.0.7 is patched. FastAPI fix 9d34ad0ee8a0dfbbcce06f76c2d5d851085024fc raises the all extra and test constraint to 0.0.7. OSV deterministic output had no lockfile findings, so this adjudication is limited to the source-declared test dependency.

misses.mechanism: Auto public-path runtime trusts document.currentScript without verifying that it is a SCRIPT element, permitting named-element DOM clobbering to supply an attacker-controlled src.
misses.behavior: For non-module output with publicPath 'auto', the generated runtime derives __webpack_require__.p from the clobbered element and later chunk loading can use the attacker-controlled base URL, enabling XSS when scriptless attacker HTML is accepted by the host page.
misses.evidence: Revision 9ac1728ee359efbbd1eb317f4a12c0f8136a690e: lib/RuntimePlugin.js:194-207 installs AutoPublicPathRuntimeModule for publicPath 'auto'; lib/runtime/AutoPublicPathRuntimeModule.js:41-63 reads document.currentScript.src without a tag check and assigns the public path. In-scope artifact provenance: security/project-structure.json:1877-1916. Upstream GHSA-4vvj-4cpr-p986 documents affected versions <5.94.0 and a patch in 5.94.0; v5.94.0 adds currentScript.tagName.toUpperCase() === 'SCRIPT'.
